name: Adreno GPU (OpenCL)
description: Qualcomm Adreno GPU via OpenCL. Faster prefill but slower decode than CPU.

performance.notes: 3x faster prefill vs CPU Q8_0 (1513ms vs 4305ms), but decode only 23.1 tok/s vs 34.2

constraints.notes: Q8_0 SOA requires single set_tensor call; multi-call corrupts tensor->extra
